products.name: Elai.io
products.note: AI avatar video; text-to-video; multilingual; enterprise training; consent

profile_text.body:
Elai is an AI video generation platform, accessible at elai.io, that describes itself as one of the most powerful AI training video generators on the market. The site presents the product as being powered by Panopto, and positions it as a tool for creating presentations and training videos using text-to-speech, AI avatars, and a text-to-video workflow. Users can select from a cast of pre-built video presenters or create a custom avatar, with the company emphasizing ease of use alongside multilingual and enterprise training capabilities.

The platform is tracked under the Video Generation and Editing category as Elai.io, with noted features including AI avatar video, text-to-video conversion, multilingual support, enterprise training use cases, and consent-based avatar creation. No litigation, patent filings, SEC disclosures, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for this company.
